pull_request.title: Tracker: establish Gen3 truth-tracking baseline with Geant4 and Fatras
pull_request.head: codex/tracker-truth-baseline
pull_request.body:
Establish an ideal-field **3 T** truth-associated ACTS Kalman baseline for the exact Gen3 nODD tracker and material map merged in PR100. Compare Geant4 and Fatras using one muon per event at fixed pT 1, 10 and 100 GeV, geometric 50×50 µm pixels, 75 µm×0.5 mm short-strip cells, and 80 µm one-coordinate long strips on the actual stereo faces.

This draft contains the reproducible native chain, configuration, analytic controls, independent preliminary assessments and the frozen hit-error training result. **The six 20k-event performance cases and final resolution/pull figures are still in progress.**

An independent 50,000-event Fatras gun (log-uniform pT 1–100 GeV, seed 142042) produced 699,273 measurements covering all 52 sensitive volumes. The unchanged ACTS `error_parameterisation.py` output is retained alongside an audited table: 106 cluster-size groups, 90 measured volume/coordinate pairs. The audit corrects the pinned script’s pooled-tail/overflow bookkeeping; no track-pull tuning or tail cuts are used. Both performance backends receive one frozen table.

Task-local native adapters correct truth measurement indexing/duplicate associations, preserve seven **unique** measurement selection, and apply trained marginal errors after native cluster merging. Native transport, clustered positions and the Kalman fitter remain unchanged. A persistent ordinary Geant4 run avoids repeated cut-table initialization while retaining one independent Geant4 event per ACTS event. Five same-seed events match the standard lifecycle exactly across generated particles, 95 hits, 80 measurements and fitted-track data.

- Governing prototype: DES-025; digitization contracts: DES-007/DES-008; source layout: ADR-008.
- Configuration and reproduction: `software/analysis/truth_tracking/README.md` and `campaign.json`.
- Training table, raw output, group audit and lifecycle comparison: `docs/validation/truth-tracking-baseline/`.
- Separate PhysVal has checked the initial metric definitions and exposed the upstream hit-error issue; exact native/training assessment is ongoing, with final six-run assessment still required.

The implementation reports generated denominators, missing/failed fits, invalid covariance, unclipped resolutions and pulls versus eta and pT. Fixed-map statistics omit training/model systematics. One-phi-bin material-map and locality qualifications from PR100 remain. **PROTOTYPE/DRAFT**: no detector design sign-off or production geometry change.

Also reconcile PR100’s merged metadata, final visible discussion and its now-finalized expert-response turn into that original account only. Tracking-baseline usage is a separate canonical account; active-turn counters remain excluded.

- both Geant4 and Fatras simulation
- material maps as of PR #100 and ACTS Gen-3 geometry 
- single muons 1, 10, 100 GeV transverse momentum,

events.text:
Which magnetic field should this first tracking baseline use? The ACTS ODD full-chain example uses a constant 2 T field; the nODD solenoid proposal has a 3 T central field but is not yet installed in the tracking geometry. I’ll use constant 2 T if you have no preference.
- Constant 2 T, matching the ODD example
- Constant 3 T, as an ideal-field nODD baseline
- The finite DES-026 solenoid field

events.text:
The runtime imports succeed, and Geant4 11.4.3 reports all 12 datasets installed. The module defaults are **75 µm × 0.5 mm short-strip cells** and **80 µm single-coordinate long strips**, with stereo supplied by the two physical sensor faces. Pixels will use the requested **50 µm × 50 µm** cells.

I’ll start with 20,000 single-muon events per momentum and backend, uniform in η and φ, and retain fit failures alongside the resolution and pull plots.
